Each part is measured against its “full marks” value and weighted. Change the values under Settings → Player tiers.
每一项都和它的“满分”值比较，再按比重计算。可在系统设置 → 玩家等级里修改。

Each player gets a score out of 100 from their total deposits, number of deposits and average deposit. The score decides the tier. Change the rules under Settings → Player tiers.
每位玩家按累计充值金额、充值次数和平均充值得出 100 分制的评分，评分决定等级。可在系统设置 → 玩家等级里修改规则。
Setiap pemain mendapat skor dari 100 berdasarkan total deposit, jumlah deposit dan rata-rata deposit. Skor menentukan tingkat. Ubah aturannya di Pengaturan → Tingkat pemain.
